headline: Buying a home in Taipei: old or new? Price gap exceeds NT$11.37 million for 40+ ping | ETtoday Real Estate Cloud | ETtoday News Cloud
summary: Homes aged 30 years or more account for nearly 60% of Taipei transaction volume. The price gap between old and new residences of 40-plus ping exceeds NT$11.37 million.
why: Housing prices and transaction patterns in Taipei indicate conditions in the property market, which affects the banks that lend against it and household wealth.
